scope: B300/SM103 individual-call CUDA Graph GPU time for local routed MoE, including adapters and combine. Excludes input quantization, router selection, shared experts, communication, attention, host submission and serving throughput.

applicability_notes.TRT-LLM: W4A8 and W8A8; tuned and native-default controls included.
applicability_notes.CUTLASS: W4A8 and W8A8; BF16-intermediate reference, tuned and default controls.
applicability_notes.Prims-TS: W4A8 and W8A8; source-defined MX scale reference, tuned and default controls.
applicability_notes.CuTe DSL: W4A8; joint same-clamp screen is separately identified. An unfinished screen is not evidence of a loss.
applicability_notes.cuDNN grouped: Requires default SwiGLU in this source revision; not interchangeable with this clamp=10 cohort. A separate default-activation screen exists.
applicability_notes.Legacy cuDNN Frost and cuTile MX: Their MX runners exclude B300 in this source revision.
applicability_notes.Cake Warp Decode: NVFP4 input and weights, not this MXFP8-input comparison.

method.selection: Rank every runner-advertised tactic plus the initial winner and native default under the same cache/routing/timing condition. Factorized backends expose stage-ranked shortlists, not all theoretical combinations. Selection timings are not reported as speedups.
method.validation: Freeze recorded tactics; run normal and reverse order in independent processes. Six changed-input graph checks and post-timing checks use each backend's declared reference.
method.timing: 16 external-event-delimited calls per graph; median across event intervals. Four warmup replays before each block, nine timed replays per block, two sweeps. Each sweep includes extra TRT-LLM blocks before and after the candidate list.
method.qualification: Original A/A, within-process repeat, cross-process and duplicate-Frost-tactic spreads must be <=1% for the admitted comparison. The reported original must be an exact minimum in both processes; exact ties include every tied name, with no winner-agreement tolerance. All-candidate and selected-pair-only qualifications remain distinct.
method.numerics: Relative L2 <1%, normalized maximum error <3%. Native CUTLASS and Prims use different intermediate rounding references; these are latency comparisons across declared numerical contracts, not interchangeable Frost tactics.
method.data: Synthetic weights and inputs; benchmark seed2107. Identical seed does not guarantee identical CUDA random tensors across different GPU SM counts or software versions.
